title: The fixture prices style acts from hand-copied model ids and seconds
instrument: a tests/next-server case: price one adopt and one generate-proofs act on the fixture (actReceipt) and on a temp-store real side (styleActReceipt) and compare each line's provider, model, seconds, usd and unpricedReason; seed red on HEAD (seconds 20 vs 21), then export imageOption/recognizeOption from lib/producers/styleLaunch.ts and have fixtureActs.ts read them
evidence:
app/(studio)/library/style/_port/fixtureActs.ts:32-36 IMAGE = {google, gemini-3.1-flash-image}, RECOGNIZE = {google, gemini-3.6-flash}, IMAGE_S = 20, RECOGNIZE_S = 8
lib/producers/styleLaunch.ts:36-60 imageOption = modelOptions('frames').find(google); recognizeOption reads TABLES.image candidates' recognize model
probe 2026-10-25: modelOptions('frames') google -> secondsPerUnit 21, usdPerUnit 0.045, basis.usd.src 'real'; fixture line seconds 20, src 'illustrative'; recognize unpricedReason differs (fixture quotes usage {input-token:1,...}, real quotes usage {})
body:
## Summary
fixtureActs.ts prices both style acts from literal model ids and assumed seconds, where the real side reads the frames catalog and the router's table.

## Description
The fixture receipt (app/(studio)/library/style/_port/fixtureActs.ts:32-36, 41-57) hard-codes the image model, the recognize model and their seconds; the real side (lib/producers/styleLaunch.ts:36-60) derives them from modelOptions('frames') and TABLES. Today the models agree and the seconds do not (20 vs 21), and the recognize line's unpriced reason is a different sentence. A table change moves the real receipt and leaves the fixture's - the screen the fixture lane photographs then prices a model the studio no longer uses. Fixed: styleLaunch.ts exports its two option builders and the fixture builds its lines from them (or from receiptFor with an empty queue).

## Flow
- price generate-proofs on the fixture and on a temp-store real side
- compare lines: seconds 20 vs 21, basis src differs
- fix: export imageOption/recognizeOption; fixture reads them; the case goes green

## Expected impact
The fixture lane's receipt matches the real side's line for line; nothing an operator does changes. Could break: live specs pinning the fixture's seconds or totals.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one authority for what a style act is priced at
Before: 2 of 5 line fields differ (seconds, src) on generate-proofs; recognize unpricedReason differs
After: 0 differ (predicted)
Method: probe - both sides priced on the same act by script; the fix touches lib/producers/styleLaunch.ts (bound-producers context), so not built here
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The preset picture path is hand-spelt in eight fixture sites outside the catalogue
instrument: git grep -n '`/presets/${' -- app lib packages : 8 app sites today -> 0, each replaced by @gt/catalog/presets thumbSrc; the existing git-ls-files picture cases (style-atelier.test.ts:53, library's) stay green
body:
## Summary
Eight fixture sites in the Board, kit and Library ports spell `/presets/<id>.jpg` themselves instead of calling the catalogue's thumbSrc.

## Description
packages/catalog/src/presets.ts:183 is the one rule for where a preset's picture lives; 1c4e9d7f moved this context's copy onto it. The other eight (board/_port/fixtureData.ts:70,185,186; kit/boardKitData.ts:37; library/_port/fixtureCharacters.ts:93; library/_port/fixtureCorpus.ts:155,179,191) are in other contexts. Fixed: each calls thumbSrc.

## Flow
- git grep the template literal
- replace each with thumbSrc(id)
- re-run the git-ls-files picture cases

## Expected impact
A move of the preset pictures reaches every fixture at once; nothing changes today. Could break: nothing - the strings are identical.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one spelling of the preset picture path
Before: 8 hand spellings in app/
After: 0
Method: probe - git grep; out of scope (other contexts' paths)
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The atelier's tab title names the style's id, not its name
instrument: a tests/next-server case: call page.tsx generateMetadata for 'painted-3d' on the fixture side and expect 'Gravitone · Painted 3D'; seed red on HEAD (it answers the id); fix with one React cache()'d loadStyle shared by the page and generateMetadata
evidence: app/(studio)/library/style/[id]/page.tsx:29-31 generateMetadata returns `Gravitone · ${decoded(id)}`; page.tsx:35 reads the view (with view.name) separately; fixtureData.ts:110-111 id painted-3d, name 'Painted 3D'
body:
## Summary
generateMetadata titles the tab with the URL id (`Gravitone · painted-3d`, `blueprint-copy`) where the page already reads the style's name.

## Description
app/(studio)/library/style/[id]/page.tsx:29-31 builds the title from the decoded param; the view read at :35 carries `name`, which is what the crumbs and the Dossier title show. Two tabs on a duplicate and its source read `blueprint` and `blueprint-copy` rather than the names the operator gave them. Fixed: one cache()'d read used by both, title from view.name, falling back to the id when the read fails.

## Flow
- open /library/style/painted-3d
- the tab reads 'Gravitone · painted-3d'
- fix: title from the view's name

## Expected impact
The operator's tabs and history name the style as they named it. Could break: a second store read per request if cache() is not used.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the tab names the work
Before: 1 of 1 atelier tabs titled by id
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: probe - read of page.tsx and the fixture seed; the instrument needs the page module under next-server, not written this round
Result: better
Gate: none
